screening_answers._work_authorization_sponsorship_NOTE: Means 'do I REQUIRE sponsorship' — answer No for domestic roles. Re-confirm before applying to a role outside your home country, where the answer may flip to Yes.

_total_experience_NOTE: Any 'total years/months of experience' field gets this value. Set by the user; use it instead of re-deriving from work_experience or trusting an ATS resume parser.
_current_company_NOTE: Answer for 'current employer / current company' fields only — do not add it to work-history rows that already list it, and do not tick 'currently working here' on a row whose end date is in the past.

work_preferences.relocation_reason: Work from office preferred, hybrid would be great
work_preferences._minimum_pay_NOTE: Expected CTC range. Free-text fields: 'XX-YY LPA (negotiable)'. Numeric-only: 'XX'.

education._start_date_NOTE: Enter the course start only where a form has its own start-of-course field.
education._grades_NOTE: Use exact values for screener questions (10th/12th %); never estimate.
